title: Consignment note
description: The hazardous waste consignment note for a movement: either its code, or a reason for having no code, but not both. For each field, null, an empty string and leaving it out all mean it is not provided. A consignment note is required when any waste item declares hazardous properties, which the service checks.

examples.reasonForNoCode: Carrier did not provide a consignment note

code.description: The consignment note code, in an EA / NRW (CJTILE/A0001), SEPA (SA1234567) or NIEA (DA1234567) format. Mirrors the hazardous waste consignment patterns from @defra/waste-movement-utils, as one pattern. Required when any waste item declares hazardous properties, unless 'reasonForNoCode' is provided; also accepted for non-hazardous waste.

reasonForNoCode.description: Free text: why there is no consignment note code. Required when any waste item declares hazardous properties and 'code' is not provided; not allowed when 'code' is provided.
